meta.name: article-illustrator
meta.description: 内容创作者和自媒体创作者在撰写长文时，当需要“给文章配图”或“添加插图”时使用。自动分析文章结构，精准识别需要视觉辅助的位置，生成并插入契合语境的插画，将抽象概念具象化，一键完成高质量图文排版，大幅提升阅读体验。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为长文自动生成贴切插画，提升阅读体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总为配图发愁
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate fitting illustrations for articles to enhance reading.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle to find images for your articles.

howto.what: 你给一篇长文（本地 Markdown 或 URL），它会逐段分析、挑出需要配图的位置，生成 16:9 插画并插入到对应段落之后，图片存进文章的 imgs/ 目录，最后报告成功与失败的张数。
howto.when: 当你要求“给文章配图”、“为文章生成插图”、“添加配图”等时接管，先分析文章结构，再逐段生成并插入图片。

say.text: 给这篇文章配图，文件在 ~/posts/ai.md
say.note: 读取该文件并逐段生成插图

say.text: 为这篇长文生成插图，每个主要章节至少一张
say.note: 按章节分析后生成配图计划

say.text: 配图用极简扁平矢量风格，插入后输出汇总
say.note: 按指定风格生成并列出结果

howto.what_en: Give it a long article (local Markdown file or URL). It scans it paragraph by paragraph, picks spots that need visuals, generates 16:9 images, inserts each after its paragraph into imgs/, and reports success counts.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to illustrate an article, add images to it, or generate illustrations for it; it then analyzes the structure and inserts images.

say_en.text: Illustrate this article - the file is at ~/posts/ai.md
say_en.note: Reads the file and plans images per section

say_en.text: Generate illustrations for this long post, one per main section
say_en.note: Builds an image plan from the sections

say_en.text: Use the minimal flat vector style, then print the summary
say_en.note: Generates in that style and lists results
